model: humiFog Multizone / Multizone Touch / Touch Oil-free - zone controller
applies_to: Zone controllers (zone cabinets) of CAREL humiFog Multizone, Multizone Touch and Touch Oil-free systems, each supervised as its own device.
summary: Each humiFog Multizone zone controller can be supervised on its own over BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP. Its list starts at address 300 and holds the zone's production request and actual production, probe readings, humidity and temperature set points and limits, supervisor request, alarm and warning flags, supervisor on/off and enable commands, zone status, control mode and versions.
notes: When connected to a zone controller, only that zone's variables are available and addresses always start at 300 (ZoneData_S structure).
Object type follows the data type column (Real = AV, Bool = BV, integers = PIV). Values are scaled 0.1 where the UoM column says 0.1.
The Multizone (+0300115EN) and Touch Oil-free (+0300127EN) manuals print the same zone tables.
Rows printed with access 'OR' are read-only. Units switch between metric and imperial with UoM_SV.

source.title: humiFog Multizone Touch pumping station and zone panel - Commissioning manual

integration.summary: Enable supervisor on/off and control for the zone, then switch it with SVOnOff and either write the humidity (or temperature) set point or a production request (SVReq). Monitor zone status, production, probe readings and the alarm and warning flags.
integration.enable: SVEnOnOff enables zone on/off from the supervisor and SVEnReg enables zone control from the supervisor; then SVOnOff switches the zone.
integration.heartbeat: Zone warning and alarm objects report a supervisor offline condition (WRO05 / WRO09).
integration.remote_sensors: SVReq (AV 331) is the zone production request from the supervisor, used when the zone control mode takes an external request.
setup: Supervisor settings are under Menu > Settings > System > BMS: BMS port address, baud, stop bits, parity, Ethernet IP settings, and BACnet MS/TP station address, max masters, max frames and device instance.
MS/TP defaults: station address 0, max masters 127, max frames 10, device instance 77000 (range 0-4194302); BMS port default 19200 baud.
Only one BACnet instance is available: BACnet cannot run on the BMS (RS485) port and the Ethernet port at the same time.
Each supervisor channel (Menu > Settings > System > Functions > Channel 1-3) is set to Supervisor or Supervisor + Controller with a protocol + port (ModBus BMS/ETH, BACnet BMS/ETH).
gotchas: Do not write variables that are not in the tables.
Values are scaled by the resolution shown (0.1 for most analog values).
